reason: The cited evidence (E1) evaluates VFeTiTaW as a bulk thermal barrier material, not as an interlayer in W–Cu composites, and reports lower microstructural stability for VFeTiTaW. It provides no data on interfacial thermal resistance, mechanical durability, or irradiation resistance of the alloy in a composite context, leaving all key premises unsupported.
